description: Resume repeats high-value keywords 10-15 times. Basic TF-IDF would give inflated semantic score. System applies diminishing returns to cap inflation.
systemBehavior: Adversarial detection triggered. Score damped via 1/log(1+freq). False positive risk reduced.
expectedMitigation: Score should be <40 despite keyword density

description: Hidden skills resume uses impact language ('shipped', 'led', '500k requests/sec') without naming tools explicitly. System misses Python, Docker, Kubernetes.
systemBehavior: Implicit phrase detection adds partial credit. Score lower than human assessment.
expectedMitigation: Implied skills detected via phrase mapping but still weighted lower

description: Chef resume contains words like 'management', 'teams', 'budget' that could confuse domain classifier. System must detect domain mismatch via skill distribution.
systemBehavior: Domain classifier assigns high HEALTHCARE/CHEF probability, low IT. Penalty applied.
expectedMitigation: Domain mismatch penalty + near-zero skill match → REJECT

description: Generic buzzword resume ('team player', 'quick learner') with no technical content. Low word count, high stop-word ratio.
systemBehavior: Low confidence due to sparse input. INSUFFICIENT_DATA or REJECT with warning.
expectedMitigation: Low confidence flag, parser warning, near-zero skill and semantic scores
